name: What is the typical timeline for fourplex construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for fourplex construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for fourplex construction can vary significantly based on factors like design complexity, permitting processes, site conditions, and material availability. Generally, the entire process, from initial design and permitting to final construction, can take 12 to 24 months. Design and permitting alone often require 6-12 months, followed by 6-12 months for physical construction. Unforeseen delays, such as weather or material shortages, can extend these durations. A detailed project schedule will be provided after initial design and planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fourplex construction typically takes 12-24 months, including 6-12 months for design and permitting, and another 6-12 months for physical building.
